description: Diagnose a defect without confusing symptoms, speculation, or retries with an evidence-backed root cause.
requiredOutcomes: The symptom and expected behavior are recorded separately.
A minimal reproduction or bounded unreproducible result is reported.
Root-cause evidence distinguishes the chosen cause from credible alternatives.
Fix scope and regression evidence are reported separately when remediation is authorized.
forbiddenOutcomes: Files are modified for a diagnose-only request.
Retries, skipped checks, or arbitrary sleeps are presented as a fix.
Secrets or raw environment values are persisted as diagnostic evidence.
A root cause is claimed from proximity or speculation alone.
